name: tpu7x
note: hw-tpu-7x, the chip page, has the spec sheet, the slice shapes and the VM; the Cloud spec page is the live source it was checked against. The spec page has no power figure; the paper and the announcement do. tpu-8th-gen compares against Ironwood. jax-tpu-info, right after the spec page, gives VMEM and SMEM per TensorCore, which no Google page states, within the four members `ask` tries. gke-plan-tpus (chips and hosts per GKE topology) is reached through search, so the paper stays within the four.

name: vllm-kv-cache

name: v6e

name: v5p

name: v5e
